semanticScope: AH-02 bounded public ordinary XQuery shared-session compile/evaluate. Adopt immutable XQuery REC https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-xquery-31-20170321/ sections 2.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.2.3 and 2.3 for captured effective module/expression contexts, dynamic evaluation and original error propagation; XDM REC https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-xpath-datamodel-31-20170321/ existing ordinary node/atomic/sequence representation. No blanket language conformance or exact numeric pipeline adoption.
hostPolicy: Preserve R2 D01/D04-D06/D11-D13. Compile reviewed SchemaXQueryCompiler signature with frozen effective prolog/registered-module/namespace closure. Optional assessor returns Unsupported without touching it; schema imports and unsupported context services/shapes refuse. Public profile is distinct from AH-01 private candidate.
capturePolicy: Dynamic context copying uses its actual binding/namespace cardinalities rechecked by existing capture, not fabricated public workload defaults or new cache/typed-atom quota units. No concurrent caller mutation guarantee or aggregate byte/time/parse budget.
resultPolicy: Permit empty, atomic and node results and flat outer sequences of these. Refuse maps/arrays/functions/external/JNode/nested sequence cells in this bounded profile, at evaluation or cell delivery. Lazy outer acquisition/advance/current/length use guarded serialized continuation windows on the exact raw operation; cached XdmSequence.Current and already-returned nodes/scalars are not recursively guarded or detached. Prefixes may be observed before a later error/refusal. No new mandatory sequence disposal slot.
ownedContext: Public evaluation owns a fresh child for the complete deferred result lifetime and preserves its effective compiled static context. Existing public legacy XQuery Evaluate and AH-01 isolated evaluator retain restoration behavior.
exclusions: No public XSLT/BCAP, schema-aware/typed-host binding, structured/nested result profile, native provider/worker/budget/freeze/owner/package/publication acceptance; PV-01/NU-01/SC-01 and remaining accepted requirements unwaived.
